const data = $input.first().json; const arrivalRows = data.arrivals.length ? data.arrivals.map(guest => ` ${guest.reservationId} ${guest.guest} ${guest.property} ${guest.checkOut} `).join("") : `No arrivals today`; const departureRows = data.departures.length ? data.departures.map(guest => ` ${guest.reservationId} ${guest.guest} ${guest.property} ${guest.checkIn} `).join("") : `No departures today`; const html = `

Daily Operations Report

Date: ${data.reportDate}

Today's Arrivals (${data.arrivalCount})

${arrivalRows}
Reservation Guest Property Check-out

Today's Departures (${data.departureCount})

${departureRows}
Reservation Guest Property Check-in

Total arrivals: ${data.arrivalCount}
Total departures: ${data.departureCount}

This report was generated automatically by the guest operations workflow.

`; return [{ json: { reportDate: data.reportDate, arrivalCount: data.arrivalCount, departureCount: data.departureCount, subject: `Daily Operations Report - ${data.reportDate}`, html } }];
